title: Police say Ann Widdecombe killed in 'targeted attack' as motive investigated
summary_cn: 英国反恐警察表示，前保守党部长安·威德科姆在德文郡家中遇害是一起“有针对性的袭击”，目前动机尚不明确。一名28岁男子因涉嫌谋杀被捕，并因涉嫌恐怖主义罪行被重新逮捕，调查人员正在审查她遇害当天早上的电视采访内容。警方强调此案尚未被正式定性为恐怖事件，但反恐调查与谋杀调查并行进行。
paragraphs_en: This video can not be played
Attack was 'targeted' - Counter Terrorism Police
Ann Widdecombe was killed in a "targeted attack" and detectives are still working to understand the motive, police have said.

Assistant Commissioner Laurence Taylor, Head of Counter Terrorism Policing, said the appearance of the former Conservative minister turned Reform UK spokeswoman on Talk TV on the morning she was killed at her home in Devon is being looked into as part of the investigation.
In an update at New Scotland Yard, he also said he did not want to rule anything out when asked if the killer could have been targeting other Reform figures.
Detectives have obtained a warrant under the Terrorism Act to hold the 28-year-old suspect arrested in Rotherham on suspicion of murder for up to seven days.
The body of Widdecombe, 78, was discovered on Thursday 9 July at her home in Haytor. She had sustained serious injuries in an attack police believe took place the previous day.
A white British man, 28, was arrested on Saturday. He was re-arrested on Monday on suspicion of the commission, preparation or instigation of acts of terrorism.
Taylor said a counter-terrorism investigation is "running in parallel" to the murder investigation but the suspected killing "has not been declared a terrorist incident at this stage".
He told reporters: "It is clear that this was a targeted attack. We are still working to understand the extent of any planning or preparation, and the motivation that sits behind that attack.
"I wouldn't want to comment on what that motivation was."
Taylor added: "There are multiple lines of inquiry that we are pursuing expeditiously, and that includes a number of digital forensic examinations."
Widdecombe served as MP for Maidstone in Kent for 23 years

The counter terrorism police chief also said he would not comment on whether they were investigating whether a foreign state was involved or on details about the planning and preparation of the attack.
"We are working through what the motivation for the attack currently is," he said.
On Monday, Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood told the House of Commons the suspect was not known to the government's Prevent anti-terror scheme.

Taylor would not comment on whether the arrest on suspicion of terror offences means the suspect potentially committed terrorism offences separate to the murder case, or whether any other politicians were potential targets.
He said: "This is a murder investigation following a brutal attack on a 78-year-old woman in her own home."
There has been a "deeply distressing impact on Miss Widdecombe's family", he added.
On Widdecombe's Talk TV appearance, Taylor said: "We are exploring all lines of inquiry and that is one of the lines of inquiry that we'll be exploring."

He said: "My request is that we don't over speculate and that we go where the investigation takes us. In terms of motive it would be wrong for me to ascribe either an ideology, or what the motivation might be at this stage."
Counter-terror police took over the investigation into Widdecombe's death from Devon and Cornwall police on Monday.
The development followed an earlier statement from Devon and Cornwall Police that, while they were keeping an open mind, there was "nothing to suggest" the murder was politically motivated.
Taylor told reporters: "Based on new information we felt it was appropriate that we took over the investigation."
In an earlier statement, Devon and Cornwall's police and crime commissioner defended the force after the investigation was handed over to counter-terror officers.

Alison Hernandez acknowledged "commentary" about the way police communicated during the early stages of the case, but described the force's response as "substantial and professional" and said it was "not unusual" for counter-terror police to become involved later.

Ann Widdecombe seen in unaired interview believed have been recorded 20 minutes before attack
It has also emerged that Widdecombe, who served as Conservative MP for Maidstone in Kent for 23 years,  gave a pre-recorded radio interview about 20 minutes before police believe she was attacked.
She spoke to British Christian radio station TWR-UK for about nine minutes via video link, but the interview was not broadcast.
The station later shared part of the recording with Times Radio, which first aired the interview on Tuesday.

In the interview, she spoke about her support for Reform UK leader Nigel Farage following his decision to re-fight his Essex seat in a by-election, amid scrutiny over his finances and a parliamentary investigation.

反恐警察称袭击是“有针对性的”
警方表示，安·威德库姆（Ann Widdecombe）死于一场“有针对性的袭击”，侦探们仍在努力查明动机。
反恐警务负责人劳伦斯·泰勒（Laurence Taylor）助理专员表示，这位前保守党部长转投改革党（Reform UK）发言人，在德文郡家中遇害当天早上出现在Talk TV上的情况，正在作为调查的一部分进行审查。
在伦敦警察厅（New Scotland Yard）的最新通报中，他还表示，当被问及凶手是否可能针对其他改革党人物时，他不愿排除任何可能性。
侦探们已根据《反恐法》（Terrorism Act）获得逮捕令，可将这名在罗瑟勒姆（Rotherham）因涉嫌谋杀被捕的28岁嫌疑人拘留最多七天。
78岁的威德库姆的尸体于7月9日星期四在位于海托尔（Haytor）的家中被发现。她在一次袭击中受了重伤，警方认为袭击发生在前一天。
一名28岁的白人英国男子于周六被捕。他于周一因涉嫌实施、准备或煽动恐怖主义行为再次被捕。
泰勒表示，反恐调查与谋杀调查“并行进行”，但涉嫌杀人事件“现阶段尚未被宣布为恐怖事件”。
他告诉记者：“很明显，这是一次有针对性的袭击。我们仍在努力了解任何计划或准备的程度，以及袭击背后的动机。”
“我不想评论那是什么动机。”
泰勒补充道：“我们正在迅速推进多条调查线索，其中包括一些数字取证检查。”
威德库姆曾担任肯特郡梅德斯通（Maidstone）议员23年
反恐警察负责人还表示，他不会评论他们是否在调查是否有外国参与，也不会评论袭击的计划和准备细节。
他说：“我们正在努力查明袭击目前的动机。”
周一，内政大臣沙巴纳·马哈茂德（Shabana Mahmood）告诉下议院，嫌疑人并不为政府的预防反恐计划（Prevent）所知。
泰勒不愿评论因涉嫌恐怖罪行被捕是否意味着嫌疑人可能犯下了与谋杀案无关的恐怖主义罪行，或者是否有其他政客是潜在目标。
他说：“这是一起针对一名78岁女性在其家中遭受野蛮袭击的谋杀调查。”
他补充说，这对威德库姆的家人造成了“极其痛苦的影响”。
关于威德库姆在Talk TV上的露面，泰勒说：“我们正在探索所有调查线索，这是我们将要探索的线索之一。”
他说：“我的要求是不要过度猜测，而是跟随调查的进展。关于动机，现阶段我既不能归因于某种意识形态，也不能说明动机可能是什么。”
反恐警察周一从德文郡和康沃尔郡警方（Devon and Cornwall Police）接手了威德库姆死亡案的调查。
此前，德文郡和康沃尔郡警方曾发表声明称，尽管他们持开放态度，但“没有迹象表明”谋杀是出于政治动机。
泰勒告诉记者：“根据新信息，我们认为接手调查是合适的。”
在调查移交给反恐人员后，德文郡和康沃尔郡的警察与犯罪专员在一份早期声明中为该警队进行了辩护。
艾莉森·埃尔南德斯（Alison Hernandez）承认了关于警方在案件初期沟通方式的“评论”，但称警方的反应是“实质性和专业的”，并表示反恐警察后来介入“并不罕见”。

安·威德库姆出现在一段未播出的采访中，据信是在袭击发生前20分钟录制的
此外，据透露，威德库姆在警方认为她遭到袭击前约20分钟，接受了一次预先录制的电台采访。她曾担任肯特郡梅德斯通保守党议员23年。
她通过视频连线与英国基督教电台TWR-UK交谈了大约九分钟，但采访并未播出。
该电台后来与Times Radio分享了部分录音，Times Radio于周二首次播出了这段采访。
在采访中，她谈到了对改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）的支持，此前他决定在补选中重新争夺埃塞克斯（Essex）席位，当时他的财务问题正受到审查，并面临议会调查。

keywords.definition_en: Directed at a specific person or group.
keywords.context_sentence: It is clear that this was a targeted attack.
keywords.context_translation: 很明显，这是一次有针对性的袭击。

keywords.definition_en: A reason for doing something, especially one that is hidden or not obvious.
keywords.context_sentence: Detectives are still working to understand the motive.
keywords.context_translation: 侦探们仍在努力查明动机。

keywords.definition_en: A person thought to be guilty of a crime or offense.
keywords.context_sentence: The 28-year-old suspect arrested in Rotherham on suspicion of murder.
keywords.context_translation: 在罗瑟勒姆因涉嫌谋杀被捕的28岁嫌疑犯。

keywords.definition_en: A legal document issued by a judge authorizing the police to arrest someone.
keywords.context_sentence: Detectives have obtained a warrant under the Terrorism Act to hold the suspect.
keywords.context_translation: 侦探们根据《反恐法》获得了逮捕令，以拘留该嫌疑犯。

keywords.definition_en: The act of causing something to happen, especially something bad.
keywords.context_sentence: He was re-arrested on suspicion of the commission, preparation or instigation of acts of terrorism.
keywords.context_translation: 他因涉嫌实施、准备或煽动恐怖主义行为再次被捕。

keywords.definition_en: Occurring at the same time and in a similar way.
keywords.context_sentence: A counter-terrorism investigation is running in parallel to the murder investigation.
keywords.context_translation: 反恐调查与谋杀调查同时进行。

keywords.definition_en: Relating to the use of scientific methods to investigate crimes.
keywords.context_sentence: That includes a number of digital forensic examinations.
keywords.context_translation: 这包括多项数字法医检查。

keywords.definition_en: To form opinions about something without having definite knowledge.
keywords.context_sentence: My request is that we don't over speculate.
keywords.context_translation: 我的要求是我们不要过度推测。
